production.note: Honda Europe gives 'EK9 (1997-2000)'. Went on sale in Japan on 22 August 1997 (Honda press release). Sold in Japan only.

body.note: 3-door; Honda's 1997 release calls it the 3-door Type R, Honda Europe calls it a hatchback.

configuration.note: B16B, water-cooled transverse inline-4, DOHC VTEC

aspiration.note: Honda describes it as a naturally aspirated engine making 116 PS per litre.

powerHp.note: 185 PS at 8,200 rpm (JIS net) x 0.98632 = 182.5, rounded to 182 hp

weightLb.note: 1,070 kg x 2.20462. Standard Type R as equipped (power steering, ABS, SRS airbag; no air conditioning). Honda's table also lists 1,050 kg and 1,060 kg for cars ordered with the ABS/airbag delete ('less option') choices, 1,090 kg with air conditioning, and 1,040 kg for the separate race-base car. 1,050 kg would be 2,315 lb.

sources.title: Civic / Civic Ferio minor change; 3-door Type R newly added (press release, 22 August 1997)

Honda celebrates 25 years of the Civic Type R

discrepancies.reason: Equipment level. Honda's 1997 specification table gives 1,070 kg for the Type R with its standard power steering, ABS and SRS airbag, and marks 1,050 kg (power steering only) and 1,060 kg as 'less option' values for cars ordered with ABS and/or the airbag deleted. Honda Europe's retrospective quotes the lightest figure, 1,050 kg.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 1,070 kg, the weight of the standard-equipment car, following the lightest-standard-configuration rule; the 1,050 kg car required delete options. The Goo-net catalog entry for the August 1997 Type R also lists 1,070 kg.
